```{r, setup, include=FALSE}

```



```{r loading, echo = FALSE, message=FALSE}

# Load data 
load("TSvectors_NEWDATA.RData")
load("TSvectors_OLDDATA.RData")


# Load packages
if (!require(forecast)) {install.packages("forecast", dependencies = TRUE); require(forecast)}
if (!require(tseries)) {install.packages("tseries", dependencies = TRUE); require(tseries)}
if (!require(lmtest)) {install.packages("lmtest", dependencies = TRUE); require(lmtest)}


```


```{r codeGranger, include=FALSE}
## Combine all data
race.WtsALL <- ts(c(race.Wts, race.WtsNEW), start = c(2007, 1), frequency = 12)
age.WtsALL <- ts(c(age.Wts, age.WtsNEW), start = c(2007, 1), frequency = 12)
dis.WtsALL <- ts(c(dis.Wts, dis.WtsNEW), start = c(2007, 1), frequency = 12)
skin.WtsALL <- ts(c(skin.Wts, skin.WtsNEW), start = c(2007, 1), frequency = 12)
sex.WtsALL <- ts(c(sex.Wts, sex.WtsNEW), start = c(2007, 1), frequency = 12)
weight.WtsALL <- ts(c(weight.Wts, weight.WtsNEW), start = c(2010, 4), frequency = 12)

race.WEtsALL <- ts(c(race.WEts, race.WEtsNEW), start = c(2007, 1), frequency = 12)
age.WEtsALL <- ts(c(age.WEts, age.WEtsNEW), start = c(2007, 1), frequency = 12)
dis.WEtsALL <- ts(c(dis.WEts, dis.WEtsNEW), start = c(2007, 1), frequency = 12)
skin.WEtsALL <- ts(c(skin.WEts, skin.WEtsNEW), start = c(2007, 1), frequency = 12)
sex.WEtsALL <- ts(c(sex.WEts, sex.WEtsNEW), start = c(2007, 1), frequency = 12)
weight.WEtsALL <- ts(c(weight.WEts, weight.WEtsNEW), start = c(2007, 1), frequency = 12)
# subset weight explicit to match the length of implicit
weight.WEtsALLshort <- window(weight.WEtsALL, start = c(2010, 4))


## Granger tests ----
# create output for 6 orders x 2 directions (implicit, explicit) x 6 attitudes = 72
grangerout <- as.data.frame(matrix(ncol = 7, nrow = 72))
colnames(grangerout) <- c("att", "direction", "order", "resdf", "df", "F", "p")
grangerout$att <- rep(rep(c("Race", "Skin-tone", "Sexuality", "Age", "Disability", "Weight"), each = 6), times = 2)
grangerout$direction <- rep(c("IE", "EI"), each = 36)
grangerout$order <- rep(1:6, times = 12)

grangerresult_I <- list()
grangerresult_E <- list()
Iatt <- list(race.WtsALL, skin.WtsALL, sex.WtsALL, age.WtsALL, dis.WtsALL, weight.WtsALL)
Eatt <- list(race.WEtsALL, skin.WEtsALL, sex.WEtsALL, age.WEtsALL, dis.WEtsALL, weight.WEtsALLshort)

# Implicit -> Explicit
for (i in 1:6){
  for (j in 1:6){
    k <- j + rep(6 * (i-1), each = 6)[j] # create successive index for storing in output
    grangerresult_I[[k]] <- grangertest(Iatt[[i]] ~ Eatt[[i]], order = j)
}}

for (i in 1:36){
  grangerout[i, c("resdf", "df", "F", "p")] <- as.numeric(grangerresult_I[[i]][2,])
}

# Explicit -> Implicit
for (i in 1:6){
  for (j in 1:6){
    k <- j + rep(6 * (i-1), each = 6)[j] # create successive index for storing in output
    grangerresult_E[[k]] <- grangertest(Eatt[[i]] ~ Iatt[[i]], order = j)
}}

for (i in 1:36){
  k <- i + 36
  grangerout[k, c("resdf", "df", "F", "p")] <- as.numeric(grangerresult_E[[i]][2,])
}

## Examine whether one direction is significant (and the other is not)
grangerout_wide <- reshape(grangerout, v.names = c("F", "p"), timevar = "direction", 
                           idvar = c("att", "order"), direction = "wide")

grangerout_wide$conclusion <- ifelse(grangerout_wide$p.IE < .05 & grangerout_wide$p.EI > .05, "I->E",
                                     ifelse(grangerout_wide$p.IE > .05 & grangerout_wide$p.EI < .05, "E->I",
                                            ifelse(grangerout_wide$p.IE < .05 & grangerout_wide$p.EI < .05, "both", "none")))

```

## Table of Output
```{r tablGrangerout, echo=FALSE}
knitr::kable(grangerout_wide,
             digits = 2,
             col.names = c("Attitude", "Order", "Residual DF", "Num DF", "F (Implicit->Explicit)", "p (Implicit->Explicit)",
                           "F (Explicit->Implicit)", "p (Explicit->Implicit)", "Inference"))
```
